description: Get a single post draft by id. Drafts are never published; draft_planned_for is a planning date only. Ids must be copied exactly from aidelly_list_drafts.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

title: Get Draft
